title: Foreign key actions inside the silver pipeline make updates slow
symptom: With one materialized view per foreign key folded into the change views, the first update ran far longer than without, most of it graph resolution
cause: Hundreds of extra views and joins in one pipeline graph (Mautic: 190 acting foreign keys)
effect: Silver latency grows with the number of foreign keys
fix: Run the actions as SQL after each update (fk-actions.py), counting orphans first so only foreign keys with work run; the in-pipeline variant stays behind FK_IN_PIPELINE=1
